title: Woman trapped in locked Sandakan room rescued
text:
SANDAKAN: A woman who was trapped inside a locked room at a house on the fourth floor of a building in Batu 5 here was rescued by the Malaysian Civil Defence Force (APM), on Tuesday.
SANDAKAN: A woman who was trapped inside a locked room at a house on the fourth floor of a building in Batu 5 here was rescued by the Malaysia n Civil Defence Force , on Tuesday.
The incident came to light after a caller contacted APM Sandakan’s emergency line, informing that his mother had become locked inside a room while the main door of the house was also locked. Advertisement An APM rescue team was immediately dispatched to the location to carry out the operation. Three officers and personnel from APM Sandakan were involved in the rescue effort, using safety equipment to gain access to the house through the fourth-floor balcony.
